description: A 429 with Retry-After: 0 then 200 (retries_used: 1); a 429 with no Retry-After then 200 (retries_used: 1, computed backoff); a 401 with retries configured but never retried (status_is_retryable(401) is false, no retries_used at all). The exact backoff wait isn't observable in committed state; pinned instead by a Rust unit test of execute_tool's own branch.
